ELI5: The HiIlary Clinton email scandal

Hillary Clinton had a secure, official, government email account for use regarding classified and official business, during her tenure as Secretary of State. Think of this as her physical inbox at work. Instead of using this account though, Clinton chose to use a personal email account, and in doing so transferred official, classified material over an non-secure medium. Think of this personal account as her home mail box. So, you could think of what she did as taking classified material, and putting it in the hands of the common mailman, to be received at her home, instead of at work.

For context, during my stint in the army we had a nearly completely insulated network for classified vs unclassified use. This was ten years ago though, but I imagine that if anything security has only elevated, especially post Snowden. So, essentially, she was taking classified material and putting it on a unsecured network (the internet), exposing it to possible eavesdropping, thus violating COMSEC protocol. Her actions don't really exhibit malice as much as they exhibit carelessness, unless she was doing it to keep her responses off the record. At best this would be carelessness enough that any regular person would lose their security clearance for an infraction like this one in a heart beat. Kind of absurd to consider that such a senior official as the secretary of state would pull this sort of irresponsible shit, but it looks like she really did. The real question is why she decided it was appropriate to violate protocol in such a way, not that there is a satisfactory answer.

She has quite a few things that I imagine she would like to keep off the books, like spying on members of U.N.
